chars.MOUNIR: MOUNIR: a 25-year-old Moroccan man with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.KHALTI: KHALTI: a Moroccan woman in her fifties wearing a dark green djellaba and a beige headscarf
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman in her early twenties with long dark wavy hair, wearing a light blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow street of a popular Casablanca neighbourhood, KHALTI stands next to an empty blue gas bottle at the door of her old house, looking around worried because her son is not there.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR lies bored on a sofa in his modest Moroccan living room scrolling his phone; through the open window KHALTI is calling his name from the street, he lifts his head.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR carries a full blue gas bottle on his shoulder, climbing the narrow tiled staircase of an old Moroccan building, straining a little.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR, gas bottle still on his shoulder, stands in front of a green painted wooden door in a Moroccan building corridor, knocking with his free hand.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KHALTI opens the door smiling warmly and welcomes MOUNIR, who holds the gas bottle on his shoulder; zellige tiles visible in the entrance behind her.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SALMA appears in the doorway next to her mother KHALTI, looking up shyly and curiously, soft daylight on her face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR frozen in the doorway with the gas bottle on his shoulder, eyes wide and mouth slightly open, completely stunned, hand on his chest.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR and SALMA look into each other's eyes in the doorway of the Moroccan house, he still holds the heavy gas bottle on his shoulder without noticing it, a quiet magical moment.
